title: Build an iOS SwiftUI medication schedule screen with Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and Reduce Motion

contextSnapshot.surface: iOS SwiftUI daily schedule and dose-confirmation screen

prompt: Build an iOS SwiftUI medication schedule screen where a user can confirm or undo a dose, inspect upcoming reminders, and remain fully legible at Accessibility Extra Large (AX3) text sizes with VoiceOver and Reduce Motion enabled.
forbiddenBehaviors: hardcodes fixed font point sizes instead of semantic Font text styles or @ScaledMetric
animates state transitions with withAnimation without reading @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)
uses raw Color.blue or Color.red literals instead of semantic asset catalog or system colors
claims iOS Simulator rendering passed from swift build alone

rubricDimensions.dimension: SwiftUI platform idioms and state clarity
rubricDimensions.pass: uses NavigationStack, semantic text styles, @ScaledMetric layout switching at AX sizes, and reversible dose confirmation with clear non-color status cues
rubricDimensions.fail: recreates web-style card chrome with fixed heights that clip at AX3

rubricDimensions.pass: gates withAnimation on accessibilityReduceMotion, groups VoiceOver rows with combined labels/actions, and keeps >= 44pt tap targets
rubricDimensions.fail: leaves unlabeled icon buttons or forces spring motion regardless of Reduce Motion

rubricDimensions.pass: labels source checks static and marks Simulator/VoiceOver/Dynamic Type checks rendered only when executed or not-checked otherwise
rubricDimensions.fail: treats Xcode/Swift compilation as visual or VoiceOver proof

negativeControls.name: compile-only pass
negativeControls.mustNot: claim AX3 Dynamic Type layout or VoiceOver navigation is rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: hardcodes fixed frame heights, raw hex colors, unguarded withAnimation springs, and omits AX3 reflow and undo state
baseline.withSkill: builds idiomatic SwiftUI with Dynamic Type reflow, Reduce Motion gating, VoiceOver grouping, tactile confirmation with undo, and honest evidence labels
